mapper.select: SELECT course_id AS courseId, title, status, progress_percent AS progressPercent, completed_lesson_count AS completedLessonCount, study_hours AS studyHours, last_studied_at AS lastStudiedAt, badge_text AS badgeText FROM v_course_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_studied_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollment (user_id, course_id, status, progress_percent, completed_lesson_count, study_hours, started_at, last_studied_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, 2, 0, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(study_hours), 0) FROM enrollment WHERE user_id = #{userId}
